acceptance_policy: Any failure or untested required invariant => CANDIDATE_NOT_ACCEPTED. Legacy review WAL incompatibility already predicted from static source; no production accommodation in this task. Host-only SIGKILL/device tests do not establish power-loss or network-filesystem guarantees. Network/device portability remains NOT_RUN.

cases.expect: Protection rejects unsigned Store.ingest and ingest_delivery; one old-key receipt, rotation, historical replay of that receipt plus denial of unseen old-key suffix; new key resumes same stream; all 30 receipts present, first acceptance epoch1 and remaining epoch2; old recorded context unchanged.
Truncated/aborted/corrupted/bad-type/oversized-value snapshots are denied with explicit reasons and zero new core receipts; rejection audits retained.

Stored read and exact five-file export preserve original context/run bytes and logical source state; repeat output and DB/sidecar namespace collisions rejected; read existing WAL and DELETE after reopen; record any physical sidecar changes.

Original thirty-receipt context reproduces within default30-second worker bound; wrong external ID, truncated context and existing output reject. Record native API result and independently observed in-memory worker PRAGMAs without altering production code.

BASELINE closed database review export succeeds. WAL live sidecars and closed WAL header currently reject SNAPSHOT_UNSUPPORTED; confirmed rejection is an acceptance-invariant FAILURE, not semantic equivalence.

Online SQLite backup and quiescent DB+WAL copy retain exact logical state. WAL DB-only copy without checkpoint may omit committed receipts and must not be sold as a backup. Record original/sidecar bytes, checkpoint elapsed/returned frame counts and reopening settings.

Real schema5 ->6 migration preserves all old tables, columns, objects and run payload; injected before-COMMIT failure fully rolls back; restored schema5 backup equals original; duplicate backup target is rejected without overwrite.
Exact original financial run, canonical five-file export, auth/history/audit/capture logical tables and ordered receipts agree across methods. SQLite pages need not agree.
